title: AppState
description: App-owned dashboard snapshot. Message and event fields are counts, not collections.

focusRemainingSeconds.description: App-calculated remaining focus time. Zero when no timer is active; paused timers retain their remaining time.

urgentMessages.description: Number of urgent messages currently awaiting attention.

upcomingEvents.description: Number of events in the app-selected upcoming window. The window is not defined by this schema.

mood.description: Initial display vocabulary; not an automatic mapping from session mode.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Time the app last updated this snapshot.
